text: Some caravan masters smuggle goods past the toll gates at night, paying the gate guards in silver to look away.
Votes in the realm's council can be bought: more than one lord has backed a war after receiving a chest of denars.
A band of deserters hides in the hills near here; they sometimes trade stolen goods with the villagers.
The local garrison has not been paid in weeks and the men grumble; some would open a gate for the right price.
Gossip says that one of the great lords of your realm has a bastard child hidden in a village, paid for in silence.
The ruler's treasury is deeper in debt than anyone admits; loans from merchant houses keep the armies in the field.
